Subject: Renewal paperwork & evidence for capacity uplift

Hi Ben,

We’re moving forward with the 18-month renewal + 2x capacity uplift discussed in last week’s exec call. Legal asked for a single packet they can review: updated MSA with your redlines, the new order form, and the evidence set for SOC/audit items. Can you confirm what you’ll need from our side and proposed signpath (who signs which doc, DocuSign vs countersign)?

Timeline: we need a fully executed agreement by 09/16 to align billing. Happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Alicia
Director, Procurement
Uptick Analytics

Alicia — thanks for the note. High level:

- We’ll provide an updated MSA (attached as Uptick_MSA_v2.pdf) with our standard Section 7 (data handling) and SLA tweaks for expanded capacity.
- Order form attached (OrderForm_Uptick_2027.xlsx) with the updated seat/throughput schedule and start/end dates.
- Evidence bundle: we have a prepared zip with SOC2 excerpts, retention policy, and audit logs sample (referenced in SLA_evidence_bundle.zip). Please confirm if you need full SOC report or summary excerpts.

Proposed signpath:
1) Uptick signs Order Form (DocuSign) -> 2) Redwood countersigns MSA (DocuSign) -> 3) Both exchange fully executed PDFs and procurement releases onboarding.

Priyom & Marissa — looping you for legal redlines and any required evidence gaps. I’ve attached the three files mentioned above.

Best,
Ben
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Uptick_MSA_v2.pdf (pdf), OrderForm_Uptick_2027.xlsx (spreadsheet), SLA_evidence_bundle.zip (zip)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork & evidence for capacity uplift

Thanks Ben — I reviewed the MSA v2 quickly. A few high-priority items for the uptick:

1) Exhibit A (Service Description): needs the exact throughput tiers called out (you already added the table — please confirm unit definitions).
2) Section 9.2 (Liability Cap): Uptick asked to keep the current cap; legal prefers our standard scaled cap for multi-term upsizes. Suggest we offer a fixed incremental cap for the uplift period only.
3) SLA credits: confirm measurement windows for burst capacity (we should avoid broad ‘‘all requests’’ windows).
4) Data residency: Uptick is US-only but requires confirmation that backups are in-region. Need exact KMS/HSM language.

I’ll prepare tracked changes and a short comment bundle. Priyom — can you check whether we can accept their ask on the liability cap with an alternate carve-out for service-affecting security incidents? Markus, flagging procurement billing impact if signpath slips.

Marissa
General Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Uptick_MSA_v2_trackchanges.docx (stub)
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Sep 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork & evidence for capacity uplift

Quick follow-up after review:

- Liability cap: we can offer a 1.5x uplift on the existing cap for the 18-month addendum window, with an explicit carve-out for willful misconduct and gross negligence.
- KMS/HSM: commit to customer-managed keys via partner KMS in US regions; will add the KMS section and a limited backup residency clause.
- Evidence: SLA_evidence_bundle contains redacted SOC2 Type II excerpts. If Uptick requires the full SOC, we can provide it under an NDA.

I’ll attach the updated MSA with tracked changes and a short redline summary for Ben to send to Uptick.

Priyom
Contracts & Ops, Redwood Inference

Thanks,
Ben
